set.body: Optimize PreparedDirectNeighborhoodExecutor for canonical D2/D3 and common contiguous leading-axis passes without changing NeighborhoodSpec semantics. Retain the arbitrary-layout generic fallback, preserve mutable ping-pong ownership rules, add differential and allocation/performance evidence, and compile/test on JVM and Scala.js where available.
set.title: Add canonical fast paths to prepared stencil executor
